thread:
Renee (AE): Heads up — HelixCare procurement paused the PO. They need a SOC 2 Type II summary, an ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A mapping excerpt, and a signed penetration-test attestation before they release funds. They also want a dedicated staging tenant for a 72h external scan.
Omar (Solutions Eng): We can spin an isolated tenant in staging. Need their scanner IP ranges and expected peak RPS. If they go heavy we’ll need reserved capacity which changes the quote.
Talia (InfoSec): We have a standard pen-test attestation template. Legal needs to approve the signer name if they insist on CISO-level. Also we require the tester to provide an insurance cert and a short test plan.
Renee (AE): Procurement specifically asked for proof of remediation on high/critical findings in the last 12 months. Can we provide something that satisfies them without exporting raw tickets?
Talia (InfoSec): Yes — we can supply a redacted remediation ledger: discovery date, severity, remediation summary, and internal reference ID. No PII or internal logs. That’s our usual redaction policy.
Omar (Solutions Eng): For authenticated scans, we can issue a short-lived service principal (48h TTL) and rotate keys after the window. We’ll stream readonly logs to a bucket, but we can't disable core audit logs.
Renee (AE): They also asked: "can you remove request/response bodies from logs during the scan?" Thoughts?
Talia (InfoSec): We can redact sensitive payloads in exported logs but cannot turn off audit logging. Recommend a filtered export that omits bodies and only shows metadata (timestamps, routes, status).
Ben (Legal): I’ll review the attestation signer and draft a 1-page SOW for the scan window that limits liability and sets allowed vectors. Exec sign-off needed if they want an officer-level signature.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Also recommend not sharing production datasets. Provide a presigned synthetic dataset instead — short expiry + IP restriction. Example:
```bash
# presign with 15m expiry
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/helix-test-data.tar.gz --expires-in 900
# then restrict bucket to their scan CIDRs
```
Renee (AE): Timeline: customer wants everything by COB Thu to avoid delaying procurement. Pricing hold until we confirm staging access + signed attestation.
Talia (InfoSec): I’ll attach SOC2 summary + Annex A excerpt and draft attestation. Will redact customer-specific mapping. Ben, please review signer & SOW.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll estimate the cost delta for a 72h isolated scan (reserved burst + ops standby). Ballpark now: +12% on Dedicated quote, depending on qps. Will firm up once they share IPs and load profile.
infra-bot: Ticket SEC-5007 created: "HelixCare evidence + staging scan coordination" assigned to Talia (InfoSec). Priority: high.
Renee (AE): Action items: Talia -> upload SOC2 + Annex A mapping + attestation draft; Ben -> SOW & signer review; Omar -> runbook and cost delta; I’ll chase HelixCare for tester name, insurance cert, CIDRs and test plan.
Renee (AE): Thanks all — I’ll update procurement and push the buyer to confirm tester and window. :handshake:
